$comment: Fixture CODE contract for contract-diff.mjs --self-test — see diff-canvas-sample.canvas.json for its paired CANVAS contract and diff-contracts.mjs for the planted disagreements this pair is designed to produce. T17 (spec 2026-08-25-contract-backed-figma-parity-and-generation) added props isChecked/isSelected and slot 'before' — planted cases (a)-(d), see their own descriptions below.
name: Self Test

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Planted disagreement #1 — this prop has no matching Figma component property in the paired canvas fixture, so it must surface as one dimension:'prop' kind:'missing-in-canvas' disagreement.

props.name: variant
props.description: Planted disagreement #2 — the paired canvas fixture's Variant axis carries an extra option ('Quaternary') this enum does not, so it must surface as one dimension:'variant-value' kind:'value-mismatch' disagreement (single entry for the whole axis, not per-option).

props.name: isChecked
props.description: T17 planted case (a) — name-normalized pair that AGREES: propNameKeys strips the leading 'is' so this pairs with the paired canvas fixture's boolean property "Checked", and the paired comparison finds nothing wrong — this must produce NO disagreement.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: T17 planted case (b) — name-normalized pair WITH a type mismatch: propNameKeys pairs this with the paired canvas fixture's "Selected" property, but that property is type BOOLEAN, not VARIANT (this code prop is an enum) — the PAIRED comparison must still report exactly ONE disagreement (dimension:'variant-axis', kind:'value-mismatch'), not a missing-in-canvas/missing-in-code split.

props.name: isExpanded
props.description: T27 planted case (e) — curated `bindings.figma.omit: true`, and the paired canvas fixture has no matching property at all (the DESIRED state for an opt-out) — must produce NO disagreement, only a `skipped` entry (dimension:'prop', reason:'intentional-omission', key:'isExpanded'), and must NOT count toward compared.props.

slots.name: before
slots.description: T17 planted case (c) — a code slot the slot<->property pairing convention must pair with the paired canvas fixture's "Slot Before" property, satisfied, with NO disagreement.

slots.name: after
slots.description: T27 planted case (f) — curated `figmaOmit: true`, but the paired canvas fixture STILL exposes "Slot After" despite the opt-out — must produce exactly ONE disagreement (dimension:'slot', kind:'present-despite-omission', key:'slot:after'), never an ordinary slot-unpaired disagreement (supersedes the old T17 case (d), which tested a code contract with no "after" slot at all — see diff-canvas-sample.canvas.json's own $comment).
